5.9.2.2.4 Rte_LdComCbkTpRxIndication
[SWS_Rte_91132] Definition of callback function Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbk
TpRxIndication
Status: DRAFT
⌈
Service Name
Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbkTpRxIndication (draft)
Syntax
void Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbkTpRxIndication (
CbkHandleIdType LdComUserCbkHandleId,
Std_ReturnType result
)
Service ID [hex]
0x103
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Non Reentrant for same sn, otherwise Reentrant
LdComUserCbkHandleId
LdCom user callback handle Id corresponding to the received
I-PDU
Parameters (in)
result
Result of the reception.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Called after an I-PDU has been received via the TP API, the result indicates whether the
transmission was successful or not.
Tags: atp.Status=draft
Available via
Rte_LdCom.h

[SWS_Rte_04625]
Status:
DRAFT

⌈
void Rte_[<Partition>_]LdComCbkTpRxIndication (
IN CbkHandleIdType LdComUserCbkHandleId,

)
where <Partition> is the shortName of the EcucPartition referenced from
the RteLdComUserEcucPartitionRef parameter (see [ECUC_Rte_09210]) of the
RteLdComUser for which the Callback is being generated.⌋
It is configured in LdComUserModuleCnf :
via the LdComUserCallbackName (See [ECUC_LdCom_00023]) parameter where
the

(See
[ECUC_LdCom_00025])
is
set
to
